title: multi-sdks: unify auth/retries, improve streaming ergonomics, parity fixes + version bumps (v1.210.0)
author: Jared Kim
description: Context: This PR standardizes auth and retry behavior across Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs, improves streaming ergonomics and backpressure handling, and includes parity fixes and coordinated version bumps to v1.210.0. Motivation: Inconsistent token refresh and retry policies were causing surprising 401s and duplicated requests under transient network failures; streaming ergonomics made it hard for consuming apps to reliably detect stream completion and handle reconnects. Scope: python, typescript, go SDK packages in the monorepo. Summary of changes: 1) Auth: centralize token refresh behavior behind a shared token manager; ensure only one refresh occurs concurrently and surface retryable auth errors with clear error types for SDK consumers. 2) Retries: adopt a consistent retry policy (idempotency-aware defaults, exponential backoff with jitter, configurable max attempts per request and per RPC). 3) Streaming: add a standardized StreamController API to surface lifecycle events (on_open, on_message, on_complete, on_error) and an ergonomic iterator/async iterator wrapper in each SDK; add backpressure-aware buffering (soft limits + drop policy) to avoid unbounded memory growth. 4) Parity fixes: align TypeScript and Go request/response shapes with Python (minor field rename fixes, consistent metadata). 5) Version bumps: bump SDK package versions to v1.210.0 and update changelogs. Migration notes: token refresh is now automatic and visible via new debug logs; consumers who previously manually refreshed tokens should remove that logic. New API: StreamController is opt-in but recommended for production streaming. Checklist: - [x] Design review (ENG-9812) - [x] Unit & integration tests added for token refresh and retry backoff - [x] Streaming e2e tests against canary server - [x] Docs updated (quickstarts + changelog) - [x] Version bump and package publish workflow tested Implementation details: auth: introduced sdks/common/auth/token_manager.py (python) and equivalent modules in ts/go; token manager uses a singleflight-like dedupe to ensure one in-flight refresh per client instance, with a 30s early refresh window for long-lived tokens. Retries: unified RetryPolicy class (common) with idempotency hints; default per-request max_attempts=3 for non-streaming RPCs, 5 for polling endpoints. Streaming: StreamController exposes start(), stop(), pause(), resume(); underlying transport now tracks last-ack timestamp and applies soft buffer_limit=128 messages with oldest-drop policy by default. Parity fixes: renamed response.metadata.trace_id -> trace_id (top-level) in TS/Go to match Python; adjusted embedding endpoint parameter order. Backwards compatibility: most changes are additive; however any consumer depending on internal auth refresh calls must migrate. Release notes included below. Why a monorepo PR: keeping changes in one PR ensures SDKs move in lockstep for behavioral parity and avoids cross-version mismatch in client apps. Rollout plan: merge to main, create release branch and coordinate package publishes in a single release workflow; monitor SLOs for auth failures and streaming error rates for 72h. CI notes: initial CI run flagged a flaky streaming e2e in TS; re-ran the job after test stabilization and CI passed.
